title: OSHA Exit Sign and Blocked Exit Checklist (29 CFR 1910.37)
subtitle: Walk every exit route and check exits, signs, lighting, safeguards and work in progress.
instructions: Mark every item OK, Defect or N/A.
Record each defect with its location, fix it or report it to the person responsible, and recheck it before signing off.
Manufacturer's instructions for signs, lighting and alarms, and your site rules, may add checks.

sections.title: Exit routes clear and safe
items: Route walked end to end with nothing blocking travel
No pallets, boxes, carts or equipment placed in the route, even temporarily
No lockable rooms on the path
Exit access does not pass through a room that can be locked, such as a bathroom
Exit access does not lead into a dead-end corridor
Stairs or a ramp present wherever the route is not substantially level
No explosive or highly flammable furnishings or decorations in the route
Route does not lead toward a high hazard area, or partitions or other physical barriers effectively shield it

sections.title: Exit signs and markings
items: Each exit clearly visible and carrying a sign reading "Exit"
No decorations or signs on or around the exit route door that hide it
Where the way to the exit is not immediately apparent, signs along the exit access point to the nearest exit and exit discharge
Exit signs visible from the exit access with nothing blocking the view
Doors that could be mistaken for exits
Marked "Not an Exit" or similar, or signed with their actual use (e.g. closet)
Sign face lit to at least five foot-candles (54 lux) by a reliable light source
Self-luminous or electroluminescent sign has a surface luminance of at least .06 footlamberts (0.21 cd/m²)
Sign is distinctive in color against its surroundings
"Exit" plainly legible, letters at least six inches (15.2 cm) high
Principal letter strokes at least three-fourths of an inch (1.9 cm) wide

sections.title: Lighting, safeguards and alarm
items: A person with normal vision can see along the whole route
Sprinklers, alarm systems, fire doors and exit lighting all working
Fire retardant paints or solutions renewed often enough to keep their fire retardant properties
Operable alarm with a distinctive signal for fire or other emergencies, unless employees can promptly see or smell a fire or other hazard in time to be adequately warned

sections.title: Construction, repairs and alterations
items: Occupied portions have their required exit routes completed and ready for use
Required exit routes available and existing fire protections maintained, or alternate fire protection of equivalent safety in place
Flammable or explosive hazards from the work
No flammable or explosive substances or equipment beyond normal permissible conditions, and none impeding exit

references: 29 CFR 1910.37: Maintenance, safeguards, and operational features for exit routes (Part 1910 Subpart E: Exit Routes and Emergency Planning)
Source: eCFR, Title 29, text as of 2026-11-09
